|strategy=By Wes Brown<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/daultaydofine.html</ref>

One half of the dynamic duo of Neimoidians in the [[Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Coruscant]] set, our man Dofine has a lot of strong and varied uses. The first part of his text is amazing. You can use all of the Force you activate at the beginning of your turn to deploy, battle and move, then use Dofine's text to grab a couple for you to draw or leave as insurance against something your opponent might try. He can also be the centerpiece of a destroyer droid deck, ensuring that so long as you're drawing battle and weapon destiny you've got characters to deploy. Put him at the [[Blockade Flagship: Bridge]] and all of your destroyer droids and battle droids just got a whole lot more dangerous!

Combo:

A lot of bang for your buck! Power 4, destiny 5 destroyers that you can take into your hand if drawn for weapon or battle destiny.
